meta.title: Kamiyama Marugoto KOSEN - Intro Page (Unofficial Demo)
meta.description: Shape the future with Technology, Design, and Entrepreneurship. A demo intro page for Kamiyama Marugoto KOSEN.
hero.lead: Kamiyama Marugoto KOSEN is a new 5-year technical college where students aged 15–20 live together in a mountain town and learn how to turn ideas into reality.
about.title: What is Kamiyama KOSEN?
about.lead: A brand new 5-year technical college opened in April 2023 in Kamiyama, Tokushima. Students aged 15 through 20 study Technology, Design, and Entrepreneurship together.
about.card1.title: Opened in April 2023
about.card1.body: The first new KOSEN to open in about 20 years, drawing students from across Japan.
about.card2.title: Kamiyama, Tokushima
about.card2.body: A mountain town of around 5,000 people, surrounded by nature and full of unique grown-ups.
about.card3.title: Residential, 5-year track
about.card3.body: Every student lives on campus, learning steadily over five years right after junior high.
about.bubble: The motto: "Nurture people who use the power of making to start things."
features.title: Three pillars of learning
features.lead: Not one narrow major — students blend three strengths to turn their ideas into real things.
features.p1.title: Technology
features.p1.body: Programming, AI, IoT, and more — learned hands-on, building real things.
features.p2.title: Design
features.p2.body: Design as the power to ask good questions and deliver value to people and society.
features.p3.title: Entrepreneurship
features.p3.body: Actually ship ideas to the world and iterate, again and again, on a small scale.
campus.title: The town itself is the campus.
campus.lead: About a one-hour bus ride from Tokushima station. Rice terraces, a river, IT ventures, and artists — this quietly unusual town becomes your learning ground for five years.
campus.feature1: 🌲 Surrounded by mountains, rivers, and rice terraces
campus.feature2: 🏡 Work on projects with grown-ups all around town
campus.feature3: 🚌 About 60 min by bus to Tokushima; easy weekend trips
life.title: A day at the dorm (sample)
life.lead: Because everyone lives together, you can keep talking, building, and dreaming with your peers well beyond class hours — on your own schedule.
life.step1.title: Good morning!
life.step1.body: Breakfast together at the dorm cafeteria, featuring warm local ingredients.
life.step2.title: Classes begin
life.step2.body: Technology and Design classes, plus hands-on project work fill the day.
life.step3.title: Your own time
life.step3.body: Clubs, projects, or visiting local grown-ups — use the afternoon freely.
life.step4.title: Chill with friends
life.step4.body: Hang out in the lounge, or jot down ideas for tomorrow with your peers.
contact.title: Want to know more?
contact.lead: Check the official site and social media for the latest news, student stories, and open-campus dates.
footer.disclaimer: This site is NOT the official website of Kamiyama Marugoto KOSEN. It is a pop-style demo page built with GitHub Copilot. For accurate information, please refer to the official website.
